articles.title: Justin Sun seeks sanctions against Trump-linked World Liberty Financial over UAE ties
articles.snippet: The Tron founder says World Liberty failed to disclose its UAE ties until months into his lawsuit over $45 million in WLFI tokens.

articles.title: Binance begins second withdrawal phase, exchange outflows slow
articles.snippet: The exchange says additional assets will become available for withdrawal from 04:00 UTC on Tuesday as security checks are completed, following an initial reopening on Sunday.

articles.title: Justin Sun Accuses Trump-Backed World Liberty of Using UAE Ties to Escape Federal Court
articles.snippet: Tron founder Justin Sun said he has asked a federal court to sanction World Liberty Financial, alleging the Trump family-backed venture delayed disclosing UAE ties that could defeat federal jurisdiction over his lawsuit.

articles.title: Mystery $106 Million Crypto Theft Hits EU Entity Days After Binance Hack
articles.snippet: Onchain investigator ZachXBT says an unidentified EU entity lost more than $106 million from centralized exchange accounts on Sunday,.

articles.title: Claude-Built Linux Exploit Targets Bug That Ubuntu Still Hasn't Patched
articles.snippet: Anthropic says Claude wrote an attack that can take over a Linux server with no password. Red Hat patched on Sunday, but Ubuntu still has no fix.
